# Octofit-tracker Fitness App React frontend Guidelines

## REACT Frontend App styling and cosmetics

- Use bootstrap tables for the data in all javascript components.
- Use bootstrap buttons for the buttons.
- Use bootstrap headings for the headings.
- Use bootstrap links for the links.
- Use bootstrap navigation for the navigation menu.
- Use bootstrap forms for the forms.
- Use bootstrap cards for the cards.
- Use bootstrap modals for the modals.
- Consistent table layouts for all components data.

These are our rules:

- We are a modern fitness app, we want to look modern and clean. 
- We want to use the latest bootstrap features and components. 
- We want to use a consistent color scheme and typography.
- We want to use a responsive design that looks good on all devices. 
- We want to use a simple and intuitive navigation menu.
- We want to use a clean and minimalistic design that focuses on the content.
- We like the Apple design style, we want to use it as an inspiration for our design.
- We want to use a consistent layout for all pages. 
- We want to use a consistent style for all components. 
- We want to use a consistent color scheme for all components. 
- We want to use a consistent typography for all components.
